label: models

configs.name: opus
configs.description: Implementer, test maintainer, and coverage reviewer on Claude Opus 5.5; everything else as harness.config.json

configs.name: mixed
configs.description: Implementer, test maintainer, and coverage reviewer on Claude Sonnet 5.5 (harness default); everything else identical

skipped_seams.implementer: Differs between configs, but cannot be isolated without adding an entry point to src/refactor/run.ts. Measured inside refactor-phase from implementer turns; isolate it only if the user agrees to the harness change.
skipped_seams.tester-loop: Differs only in the coverage reviewer; same isolation problem. Measured inside refactor-phase.
skipped_seams.test-maintainer-adapt: Differs between configs; only triggers when a diff breaks existing tests; not isolatable. Measured inside refactor-phase when it happens.
skipped_seams.test-maintainer-replace: Differs between configs; only triggers when the tester flags needs_refactor tests; not isolatable. Measured inside refactor-phase when it happens.
skipped_seams.screener: Same model (Composer 2.5) in both configs, and --item skips screening.
skipped_seams.reviewer: Same model (Opus) in both configs; its verdict feeds items_committed.
skipped_seams.end-to-end: The analysis phase uses the same models in both configs; running it would add cost and noise without bearing on the question. refactor-phase is the end-to-end run for the part that changes.

grader: gpt-5.6-sol-medium, one grader for all trials, blind (opaque ids, shuffled), rubric .benchmark/fixtures/refactor-phase/rubric.md parts A and B. A non-Claude grader avoids judging Opus against Sonnet with a Claude model.

estimate.basis: No prior refactor runs exist, so no per-trial data. Plan: run trial 1 of each config as a pilot (2 items each), read cost and time from manifest.json, extrapolate to 3 trials x 2 configs, and confirm with the user before trials 2 and 3. Worst case per item is bounded only by harness timeouts (refactorer 30, tester 60 per turn with up to 6 rejections, implementer 30 per attempt x 2, test_maintainer 60, reviewer 20 minutes). Composer 2.5 turns (auditor, test-change and comparison reviewers) have no price in harness.config.json, so cost excludes them unless the user supplies one.
